title: Happy Number
summary: Repeatedly replace n with the sum of the squares of its decimal digits.
statement: Repeatedly replace n with the sum of the squares of its decimal digits. Decide whether this process reaches 1.

examples.explanation: The sequence reaches 1 after several replacements.
The sequence returns to 4 without visiting 1.

hints: Conceptual: A repeated value means the sequence will repeat.
Directional: Use two runners moving at different speeds to detect a cycle.
Implementation: Compute the digit-square sum with division and remainder. Stop when the runners meet, then check whether they met at 1.
complexityAnalysis: O(log n) time and O(1) extra space for the bounded digit process.
